{"reason": "All 8 shown failures are truth=demand-forecast-error mislabeled unknown: three have forecast-bias below the 0.1 cutoff (0.081/0.067/0.065) and five have market-mismatch=#f rows ignored. I add market-signal-mismatch? as an alternative trigger for demand-forecast-error and lower the bias threshold 0.1->0.06, recovering these amounts while keeping the supplier-delay branch first.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
